_doc: Signatures (regex, case-insensitive) and gate thresholds. Override with --thresholds my.json (deep-merged).

crash._doc: any unexpected fatal or fw_crash event = FAIL; scenarios that inject crashes declare expected counts

timeouts._doc: candidate WMI/HTT timeout lines > baseline = FAIL; equal and >0 = WARN (pre-existing)

peer_leak._doc: after teardown+cooldown, station dump and driver peer list must both equal expected

slab_slope._doc: least-squares slope of active_objs vs loop index; candidate slope minus baseline slope is gated when a baseline exists

recycler._doc: post-cooldown pool total must return to pre-scenario total

throughput._doc: median iperf3 Mbps, candidate vs baseline

kmemleak._doc: new wlan-related unreferenced objects vs baseline = FAIL

recovery._doc: scenarios that inject a crash must observe it and pass every recovery check
